name: Judges
lede: The seventh book of the Bible, in full: the judges Jehovah raised up, from Othniel to Samson, and the days when there was no king in Israel, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: After the Death of Joshua
books.blurb: Judah shall go up: Adoni-bezek, Jerusalem and Hebron, Othniel and Achsah's springs, Beth-el taken by its entrance, and the tribes that drove not out the Canaanites; the angel of Jehovah at Bochim, a generation that knew not Jehovah, and the judges Jehovah raised up.

books.name: Deborah
books.blurb: Othniel; Ehud the left-handed and Eglon king of Moab in his cool upper room; Shamgar's ox-goad; Deborah under her palm-tree, Barak and the ten thousand on mount Tabor, nine hundred chariots of iron swept away by the Kishon, Jael's tent — and the Song of Deborah: From heaven fought the stars.

books.name: Gideon
books.blurb: Midian as locusts for multitude; the angel of Jehovah under the oak at Ophrah — Jehovah is with thee, thou mighty man of valor; the altar of Baal thrown down by night; the fleece wet and dry; three hundred men that lapped; the cake of barley bread; trumpets, pitchers and torches: the sword of Jehovah and of Gideon.

books.name: Abimelech
books.blurb: Faint, yet pursuing: Succoth and Penuel, Zebah and Zalmunna; I will not rule over you, Jehovah shall rule over you; the golden ephod in Ophrah. Then Abimelech made king at Shechem, Jotham's fable of the trees and the bramble, Gaal and Zebul, Shechem sowed with salt, and the tower of Thebez.

books.name: Jephthah
books.blurb: Tola and Jair; go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; Jephthah the Gileadite, son of a harlot, fetched home to be head over Gilead; his answer to the king of Ammon; the vow, and his daughter coming out with timbrels; Shibboleth at the fords of the Jordan; Ibzan, Elon and Abdon.

books.name: Samson
books.blurb: The angel of Jehovah to Manoah's wife: no razor shall come upon his head; the name that is wonderful, and the angel ascending in the flame of the altar. Samson, the young lion and the honey, the riddle at the feast, three hundred foxes with firebrands, the new ropes like burnt flax, and the jawbone of an ass.

books.name: Delilah
books.blurb: The doors of the gate of Gaza carried to the top of the mountain; Delilah in the valley of Sorek and the lords' silver; the green withes, the new ropes, the web — the Philistines are upon thee, Samson; the seven locks shaven; the prison-house in Gaza; and the two middle pillars of the house of Dagon.
